title: SOC2 prep scratchpad - Hailey Ward
content:
Purpose: quick personal notes for SOC2 Type 1/2 prep - mapping controls, identifying evidence, and callouts for engineering owners. Working doc, expect lots of TODOs and incomplete assumptions.

Scope: Redwood hosted API + Dedicated control plane + Private (baseline controls only). Exclude: customer-managed on-prem infra outside our control.

High-level open questions:
- Exact timeframe we are targeting for Type 1 vs Type 2? (ask Ami / Legal) -> JIRA-SEC-1423 created to track timeline.
- Are we including Dedicated customers under same control set or separate scoping? Need product decision.

Control mapping (rough):
- Access controls (logical access): owners: Ryan Chen (eng-sre) + Maya Singh (IAM)
  - Evidence candidates: Okta admin logs, onboarding/offboarding checklist, role matrix (confluence), recent access review export (CSV)
  - Gaps: automated monthly access review not formalized -> TODO: put process in place, JIRA-SEC-1489

- Change management / change control: owner: Release Engineering (Lena Morales)
  - Evidence: change tickets + approvals, deploy checklist, rollback runbook, CI run history (CircleCI/GitHub Actions logs)
  - Notes: need one-month snapshot of approved changes for the audit sample - ask RE to tag change tickets with "SOC2-audit-sample" label

- Incident response / availability: owner: Site Reliability (TBD)
  - Evidence: incident postmortems, pager duty rotation, runbook links
  - Gap: retention of postmortems in a central place (move to confluence/incident-log)

- Data encryption / key management: owner: Platform Engineering
  - Evidence: KMS usage logs, key rotation policy doc, code references for envelope encryption
  - TODO: confirm HSM usage for Private deployments (product confirm)

Quick evidence checklist (for collection):
- Okta/SCIM logs export (last 12 months)
- Onboarding/offboarding checklist template (confluence page id)
- Change ticket list (last 1 month) + approvals
- CI/CD run logs tied to deploy IDs
- Access review CSV (signed by manager)
- Incident postmortems (last 12 months)
- Policy docs: Acceptable Use, Data Retention, Encryption, Backup/Restore

Immediate action items (owner - due):
- Draft access review process + template (Maya Singh - 2024-11-15) -> follow up in weekly sync
- Ask Release Eng to add SOC2 audit label and export sample (Lena Morales - 2024-11-22)
- Create central incident-log confluence page and migrate recent postmortems (SRE lead - 2024-12-01)
- Confirm encryption/HSM details for Private (Platform Eng - 2024-11-20)

Blockers / dependencies:
- Product decision on whether Dedicated counts as in-scope or not (blocks a bunch of evidence collection).
- Legal confirmation on Type 1 vs Type 2 timeline (affects sample window).

Meeting notes / quick sync plan:
- Weekly SOC2 working group: Friday 11am PST. Agenda: evidence collection status, blockers, sample selection.
- Bring sample list to the week-of review with auditors (expect to be asked for 30-90 day samples for Type 1?).

Random scratch ideas:
- Could use a small script to pull Okta exports and anonymize then store in artifacts bucket (helps handoff to auditors).
- Tagging pattern: "soc2-evidence-<control>-YYYYMMDD" to keep exports discoverable.

Notes to self: keep this doc minimal - move finalized mappings into Confluence / control-mapping spreadsheet. This file is a personal scratchpad for coordination.

References / pointers: see CONFLUENCE-SEC/SOC2-Overview for control matrix template, link to sample policy drafts in product/security drive.

End of scratchpad.
